name: Closer
blurb: Real conversation that feels like winning.

cards.text: Tell them the specific thing they did this week that you keep replaying in your head. Specific or it doesn't count.
Finish this out loud, one each: 'I've been wanting to tell you…' No interruptions — the blank does the work.
cards.soften: Write it down, trade papers, read theirs silently.

cards.text: One true thing each, 60 seconds. The listener's only job is to listen — no fixing, no comebacks. Then trade.
If our relationship were a song right now, what's playing? Name it and defend it in one sentence.
What's something you miss that we used to do — not from lack of trying, just life? Name it. It goes back on the calendar this week.
Hold their hands and look at their eyes. Say the thing you've been carrying this week that's heavier than it should be.
cards.speak: They just hold your hands. That's the whole rule.
cards.soften: Sit back-to-back and say it without eye contact.

cards.text: The menu game: each build a three-item menu — one thing you want more of, one you want less of, one you're curious to try. Trade menus. Each picks one item to 'order' this week.
Make one wish about us out loud. The other answers either 'wish granted' (this week) or 'wish deferred' (name a date). No negotiating, no explaining.
Plan our next perfect Sunday out loud, minute by minute, starting at 9am. Both hands on the wheel.
Do one tiny act of service for them right now, without asking what they want. They close their eyes while you decide.
cards.soften: Tell them what you WOULD do, and when.

cards.text: What's a question you wish I'd ask you more often? I'm asking it now. Answer it slow.
Each say one thing you'd change about us if you had a magic wand. Wand-holders collect wishes — no defending, no explaining, just 'ok'. Wishes get re-read next month.
cards.soften: One wish each, deferred answers allowed.

cards.text: Slowly take off one item of their choosing.
cards.speak: While you do, tell them what you love about the person underneath, not just the skin.
cards.soften: Hold their hand against your heart for 30 seconds instead.

cards.text: Whisper the moment you knew you were done for. Be precise — the minute, the light, the sound in the room.
Kiss their neck for 30 slow seconds.
cards.speak: While you do, tell them the moment this week you were proudest of them.

cards.text: Trade answers: what's a small thing the other did today that you noticed and appreciated silently? Silent appreciations get said now.
